# Major new features

## OIDC back-channel logout - #2740

Warpgate now accepts OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout requests at `/@warpgate/api/sso/providers/<name>/backchannel-logout`. When the identity provider signs a user out, it ends their Warpgate sessions on every cluster node. The new `disable_local_logout` provider option hides Warpgate's own "log out" button when the provider supports single logout.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/warp-tech/warpgate/compare/v0.30.0-beta.2...v0.30.0-be

# Major new features

## Vault-signed SSH certificates for target authentication - #2734

﻿一次外部审计按 `ec77e34` 复现了 7 个问题，全部确认并修复。每条都有回归测试（20 → 49）。

### 修了什么

- **安全：写接口可被跨站触发。** `/api/onboard` 不校验来源，且把非 JSON 请求当成空配置处理，任意外部页面用普通表单 POST 就能清空用户的兴趣偏好。现在校验 `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site`，非 JSON 返回 415。
- **安全：可以给不存在的仓库评分。** `/api/rate` 不检查仓库是否存在。现在

- **The Claude Code plugin now ships from a `stable` branch instead of `main`.** The release workflow moves the branch to each tag once the release is published, so a plugin change can no longer reach users ahead of a server it needs. CI now compares the plugin's `version` with the one on `stable`, so a changed plugin can't reuse the version users already have. An existing install moves over on its next update, which may need `claude plugin marketplace update oracle-forms-mcp` first.
